facts.value: Admission is guaranteed to the university, but not necessarily to your original major or program.
Deferment may be granted for up to one year for most other students including international students on an F-1 visa.
You cannot attend another college or university during your deferment.
If you defer and plan to return in a different semester than approved, contact Admission Services.
Test scores are valid for two years from the test date.

Common reasons include religious volunteer work, volunteer service, U.S. military service, international military service, Student Visa Denial or inability to obtain a visa appointment, financial or personal reasons.
Approval is required for scholarship deferment through Financial Aid and Scholarship Services.
To withdraw, sign in to My ASU.
You are still responsible for any housing or university charges you already owe.
Registering for classes means you agree to pay tuition and fees.
You must withdraw from all classes before the refund deadline or you will owe full tuition.
